interpretation.supported: On one preregistered new-seed audit, the symmetric finite-state mask repaired every observed L1 role-binding and serialization failure with no regression and negligible visible-token change.
interpretation.efficiency: One-beam masked greedy avoided the earlier four-beam repair's approximately 61 percent latency penalty; its measured overhead was 2.55 percent on this run.
interpretation.boundary: The five discordant pairs give an exact two-sided McNemar p-value of 0.0625. Independent replication and a matched JSON control remain required before claiming general reliability parity or an end-to-end cost improvement.
